g.text: Blue ranges: chosen cellwise deterministic box extrema, not confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Each scalar has its own extremizer. No full-domain, event-law or recoil inference. Childers et al. (2004), Table IV.
